dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge features a profound inward-curving spline, interrupted by a significant sharp-angled notch in the upper third, deviating from standard falcate curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, pointed geometry with a very small pixel radius at the tip, appearing as a residual hook-like structure due to adjacent tissue loss.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 65-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.0:1.1, measuring the ratio of the maximum base width at the ridge to the maximum vertical height of the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, deep semi-circular notch/amputation on the upper trailing edge of the dorsal fin. Additional minor irregular serrations visible along the lower trailing edge. Punctate white markings visible along the mid-anterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific residual 'hook' shape of the fin apex resulting from the large excision immediately below it.
